label: coach_teacher_ecology_first_00
text: 大家好啊～大家好。[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_first_01

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_00
text: 哇～[VAR 0x0100(0000)]。\n我們最近很常見面呢～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_01
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳現在正在\n這裡交換留學對吧～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_02
text: 身為[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的班導師！\n我也來這邊看看[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳過得好不好喔～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_03
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]，什麼是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳在藍莓學園\n特別努力的事情呢～？[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

text: 收集圖鑑！

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_select_03
text: 交朋友！

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_04
text: 真不愧是冠軍級的訓練家～！\c\n看來連在對戰的強校\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳也發揮了實力，我好高興啊～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳在這裡也有身體力行地

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_04c
text:
哇～[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳已經交到
許多的新朋友了嗎～？\c
下次請務必也把他們

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_05
text: 和夏令營的時候不一樣，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳這次是一個人來留學，\r\n所以我還蠻擔心的……[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_06
text: 但[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳似乎過得很開心，\n真是太好了～！[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_00
text: 對了，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]。\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳在生態巨蛋都是用\r\n什麼樣的圖鑑App呢～？[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

text: 藍莓圖鑑！

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_select_02
text: 你要看看嗎？

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_01

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_02
text: 我的App是開源軟體，\n因此可以自由地增加要素……[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_03

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_04
text: 哎呀～？這個人寫程式碼的風格\n和克拉韋爾校長很像呢～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_05

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_06
text: ……改得很好呢。\n謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳告訴我～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

text: 我也把藍莓圖鑑\n加到App裡了～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_select_01
text: 太棒了！

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_select_02

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_02
text: 嗯～！藍色的設計\n看起來也很帥氣～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_02b
text: 嘿嘿……\n不小心就變得跟[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一樣了～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_03
text: 我想完成圖鑑，\n所以會去生態巨蛋走走繞繞，\r\n那裡真是讓我太～興奮了～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_04

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_05
text: 各式各樣的寶可夢\n都舒舒服服地棲息在那裡……[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_06

label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_01_00

label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_01_01
